title: Echo bi yegg ci tron ​​bi
intro: Mu am nit ku yaatu, mu jegesi toogukaayu àttekaay bi, seen baat di lox, du ndax tiitaange waaye ndax yaakaar. Mbir mi nekkoon na ku nekk, waaye dogal bi dina wéy di dox ci diir bi, di dindi cosaan ak aada bu daan sonal nit ñi. Kan mooy ruuh gi ñuy dégg ñaxtam ginaaw biddiiw yi?
clues: Maa ngi ñëw ak xol bu diis, di sàkku yoon ci mbir mu tënk sama làmmiñ.
Sama ñaan nekkul woon ab ndaw rek; mu yéeg fu sori, dem ci Kiy dégg lépp.
Kàddu yi ñu waxoon ci man dañu melni ay caden yu yàgg.
Ma waxtaan ak xalaat, ak ay rangooñ ak xel mu dal, ngir sama ngor.
Benn feeñu wàcci, noppiloo anam yu yàgg yi, nangu sama metit.
Dañu may woowe ki xëccoo sama jëkkër, ba noppi sama tur nekkoon luy nuru chapitre bi ma moomal.

Yaayu Musaa

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
